description: Backend data-access layer that the new read-only REST endpoints will consume. Adds a spectrum snapshot export to SpectrumTable (without changing its existing isFree/occupy/release/contains/slotCount behavior), and adds read accessors to RsaService/RsaManager: listActive() (all accepted, not-yet-released RsaResults), a slotCount getter, and a spectrum-snapshot getter. Also adds a minimal blocked-request counter in RsaManager so the stats endpoint can report blockedCount. This feature is a prerequisite for FEAT-002 (the web resources). It touches only backend classes and leaves the app buildable with no REST changes yet.
steps: In apps/rsa/src/main/java/org/onosproject/rsa/SpectrumTable.java add immutable snapshot value classes and an export method WITHOUT altering any existing method. Add a public static final class LinkSpectrum with: ConnectPoint src, ConnectPoint dst (the undirected key endpoints), int slotCount, immutable List<Integer> occupiedSlots (sorted set bit indices), int freeSlotCount, int maxContiguousFree (longest run of consecutive free slots), and immutable List<ReservationView> reservations. Add a public static final class ReservationView with String requestId, int startSlot, int width. Add a public static final class SpectrumSnapshot with int slotCount and immutable List<LinkSpectrum> links. Add `public synchronized SpectrumSnapshot snapshot()` that walks the occupancy map and reservations map and builds the views. For each undirected LinkKey in occupancy: derive src=key.src() and dst=key.dst() as ConnectPoint; compute occupiedSlots from the BitSet (stream of set bits < slotCount); freeSlotCount = slotCount - occupiedSlots.size(); maxContiguousFree by scanning the BitSet for the longest zero run in [0,slotCount). To attach reservations per link, iterate the reservations map (requestId -> List<Reservation>) and group each Reservation by its (already undirected) link into the matching LinkSpectrum. Keep everything inside the existing `synchronized` discipline (the new method is itself synchronized, consistent with the class). Add javadoc. Do NOT change DEFAULT_SLOT_COUNT, slotCount(), isFree, occupy, release, contains, undirected, bits, or the Reservation inner class.

In apps/rsa/src/main/java/org/onosproject/rsa/RsaService.java add three read-only methods with javadoc: `java.util.Collection<RsaResult> listActive();` (returns all currently-accepted, not-yet-released results), `int slotCount();` (slots per link from the spectrum table), and `SpectrumTable.SpectrumSnapshot spectrumSnapshot();` (current occupancy snapshot). These are additive to the interface; do not touch assign/release/get signatures.

In apps/rsa/src/main/java/org/onosproject/rsa/RsaManager.java implement the three new interface methods. listActive(): return an immutable copy of results.values() (e.g. com.google.common.collect.ImmutableList.copyOf(results.values())) so callers cannot mutate internal state; results is already a ConcurrentHashMap so the view is thread-safe to iterate. slotCount(): return spectrumTable.slotCount(). spectrumSnapshot(): return spectrumTable.snapshot(). Add a `private final java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong blockedCounter = new AtomicLong();` and increment it at each existing `return RsaResult.blocked(...)` site inside assign(...) (there are three return-blocked sites: invalid slot count, no path, no contiguous segment). Add `public long blockedCount()` returning blockedCounter.get(), and declare `long blockedCount();` in RsaService with javadoc. Do NOT change the routing/first-fit/intent-building logic or the null-provider vs real-OchPort branch in buildIntent.

Verify the public contract compiles by building the oar (the app has no unit tests yet). Optionally add a JUnit test SpectrumTableTest under apps/rsa/src/test/java/org/onosproject/rsa/ asserting that after occupy() the snapshot() reports the expected occupiedSlots/freeSlotCount/maxContiguousFree and that reservations carry the requestId; if added, it is picked up automatically by osgi_jar_with_tests.
acceptance_criteria: SpectrumTable.snapshot() returns a SpectrumSnapshot whose links reflect current occupancy (occupiedSlots, freeSlotCount, maxContiguousFree) and reservations (requestId/startSlot/width), and none of SpectrumTable's pre-existing methods changed signature or behavior.
RsaService exposes listActive(), slotCount(), spectrumSnapshot(), blockedCount(); RsaManager implements them; assign/release/get are unchanged.
blockedCounter increments on each blocked assign result.
verification: If a SpectrumTableTest was added: cd /home/manager/build/onos-2.7.0 && JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-11-openjdk-amd64 bazelisk test --host_force_python=PY3 //apps/rsa:... (the generated test target) and confirm it passes.
findings:
Implemented purely additively; existing SpectrumTable (isFree/occupy/release/contains/slotCount/undirected/bits/Reservation/DEFAULT_SLOT_COUNT) and RsaManager (assign/release/get, routing/first-fit/intent-building, null-provider vs OCH branch) unchanged.

SpectrumTable.java: added three public static final value classes and a snapshot() method:
- ReservationView(String requestId, int startSlot, int width) with accessors requestId()/startSlot()/width().
- LinkSpectrum(ConnectPoint src, ConnectPoint dst, int slotCount, List<Integer> occupiedSlots, int freeSlotCount, int maxContiguousFree, List<ReservationView> reservations); lists stored via ImmutableList.copyOf; accessors src()/dst()/slotCount()/occupiedSlots()/freeSlotCount()/maxContiguousFree()/reservations().
- SpectrumSnapshot(int slotCount, List<LinkSpectrum> links) with slotCount()/links() (ImmutableList).
- public synchronized SpectrumSnapshot snapshot(): walks the occupancy map (one LinkSpectrum per undirected LinkKey that has a BitSet entry); occupiedSlots = set-bit indices < slotCount (sorted ascending by nextSetBit); freeSlotCount = slotCount - occupiedSlots.size(); maxContiguousFree via private longestZeroRun(BitSet) scanning [0,slotCount). Reservations are pre-grouped from the reservations map (requestId -> List<Reservation>) into a map keyed by the Reservation's already-undirected LinkKey, then attached to the matching LinkSpectrum. New imports: com.google.common.collect.ImmutableList, org.onosproject.net.ConnectPoint.
NOTE for FEAT-002: snapshot() only emits links that have an occupancy BitSet entry (a BitSet is created lazily on first isFree/occupy/bits call). Links never touched have no entry, so a fully-idle topology yields an empty links[] list. If the stats/spectrum endpoint must enumerate ALL topology links (including idle ones), FEAT-002 should merge in LinkService.getActiveLinks() rather than relying on snapshot() alone. occupiedSlots is sorted ascending.

RsaService.java: added four additive interface methods (javadoc included): java.util.Collection<RsaResult> listActive(); int slotCount(); SpectrumTable.SpectrumSnapshot spectrumSnapshot(); long blockedCount(). assign/release/get signatures untouched.

RsaManager.java: added private final AtomicLong blockedCounter = new AtomicLong(); incremented at all three return-blocked sites in assign() (invalid slot count, no path, no contiguous segment). Implemented listActive() = ImmutableList.copyOf(results.values()) (results is a ConcurrentHashMap, safe to iterate), slotCount() = spectrumTable.slotCount(), spectrumSnapshot() = spectrumTable.snapshot(), blockedCount() = blockedCounter.get(). New imports: com.google.common.collect.ImmutableList, java.util.Collection.

No JUnit test added (optional per step 4; app still ships no src/test). Verification: build-only per context.json; `bazelisk build --host_force_python=PY3 //apps/rsa:onos-apps-rsa-oar` succeeded (oar at bazel-bin/apps/rsa/onos-apps-rsa-oar.oar). No live-pod hotswap done in this step (REST endpoints arrive in FEAT-002).
